content.text: The available time-series store only contains zone air temperature streams (sensors, heating/cooling setpoints). There are no electricity power/energy series, even though the building graph has a `Building_Electrical_Meter` and many `Electric_Power_Sensor` points. So the whole-building electricity use cannot be determined from the data.
